title: Proving Lehner's formulas via RDT -- indefinite and asymmetric scenarios
summary: The strong asymptotic freeness established in [28,53] allows for the study of norms of Gaussian matrix polynomials via corresponding free operator counterparts. For spectral edges of semicircular free counterparts to symmetric Kronecker-Gaussian matrices, Lehner in [39] determined closed-form analytical characterizations. As an alternative to classical spectral methods, in [62], we created a Random Duality Theory (RDT) based framework for studying these problems and reproved Lehner's formula for definite matrix coefficients.
